tools.name: geocode

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest address or place to a latitude/longitude, from OpenStreetMap data. Counts 1 address lookup against the account's monthly cap. Same storage terms and attribution as geocode.

tools.name: static_map
tools.description: Render a map as an image (returned inline) with optional pins (markers) and a line (path, e.g. a route). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: static_map, map_setup · Private data: static_map, privacy_area_map · Public sink: district_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: static_map, map_setup · Private data: static_map, privacy_area_map · Public sink: district_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
